2. eMudhra intermediate CA compromise

Source: HackerNews | Topic: hn | Coverage: 2 sources | Discussion

Summary

A security compromise has been identified involving an intermediate certificate authority (CA) operated by eMudhra. This incident potentially impacts the integrity of certificates issued under that authority. Security teams are currently investigating the scope of the breach.

My Take

Nothing says 'trust the internet' like finding out the digital notary who stamped your passport is actually a guy in a trench coat behind a dumpster. It’s a reminder that our entire security infrastructure is held together by digital duct tape and the hope that nobody is looking too closely. Always remember that a certificate is only as secure as the weakest link in the chain of trust.
